newsitem.title: USA: Fox picks WTN as global new provider.
newsitem.headline: Fox picks WTN as global new provider.

text.p: News Corp Ltd's Fox News unit chose Worldwide Television News (WTN) as global news provider to the Fox News Channel to be launched in the United States on October 7, WTN said on Thursday.

WTN, primarily owned by the ABC News unit of The Walt Disney Co, will also provide facilities, news-gathering crews and video for a news-feed service to Fox affiliated television stations, WTN said in a news release.
Financial details were not disclosed, and a WTN spokesman was not immediately available for comment.
WTN said Fox News will have access to all WTN technical facilities and crews in 125 bureaus and will also use WTN's 24-hour news service.
The Fox News Channel is a general news scheduled to launch October 7 in some 10 million U.S. homes.
